checklist.item: Lint and typecheck. Every finding of the repository's own lint (biome, SonarJS) and typecheck (tsc) scripts on main.
checklist.evidence: bun run lint (biome check . && pulse-eslint .): exit 0; Biome 'Checked 136 files in 174ms. No fixes applied. Found 2 infos.': lint/style/useTemplate at bench/compare.ts:239:59 and lint/complexity/noUselessSwitchCase at src/service.ts:671:7 (style only, notes), plus a deprecation of the 'recommended' field in the shared pulse-config biome.json:41 (note). ESLint (SonarJS, typescript-eslint): no output. bun run typecheck (tsc 7.0.2 --noEmit): exit 0, no output. bun run check: exit 0. pulse-eslint --no-inline-config shows what the disable comments hide in production code: sonarjs/cognitive-complexity at src/server.ts:527 (finding 3), function-return-type at src/server.ts:139 and src/admin-routes.ts:102, no-nested-conditional at src/service.ts:372; 53 directives in tests silence fixture rules.

checklist.item: Complexity. The functions with the highest cognitive complexity, with their value against the budget of the shared configuration.
checklist.evidence: Shared budget: sonarjs/cognitive-complexity 15 (pulse-config eslint.config.js). pulse-eslint --no-inline-config --config eslint.cc.config.js -f json src bench (the shared config with the threshold set to 0, audit copy only), exit 1, 452 functions above 0. Highest: 52 handle src/server.ts:527 (over by 37, silenced by eslint-disable-next-line at src/server.ts:526, finding 3); 15 runLoad bench/load.ts:176; 15 admin handler src/admin-routes.ts:221; 15 tick src/heartbeat.ts:35; 15 ingest transaction src/service.ts:881 (all four at the budget); 13 write src/admin-routes.ts:162; 12 uptimeOf src/service.ts:750; 12 run src/start.ts:122; 11 parseProbed src/config.ts:150; 11 checkMeasurements src/server.ts:108; 11 validateResult src/server.ts:139.

checklist.item: Duplicated logic. Logic that two or more files of this repository, or this repository and another pulse repository, implement separately.
checklist.evidence: grep over src/ of api, probe, status, notify, kit, contract and reading. validateResult re-checks what the contract validator already checks (src/server.ts:146-156, 109-110, 113 after src/server.ts:144; finding 9). isRecord in api src/config.ts:31, src/config-write.ts:94, src/tokens.ts:58, probe src/check.ts:237 and src/check-domain.ts:73, status src/poller.ts:106, while pulse-contract exports isObject (src/validate.ts:57). err.code readers with three fallbacks: src/backup.ts:25, src/config-write.ts:77, src/config-reload.ts:47 (also probe src/attempt.ts:20, notify src/channels/smtp-send.ts:91). HttpError/sendError (src/server.ts:58, 68) and RouteError/sendError (src/admin-routes.ts:62, 128); BodyError 'aborted' mapped to two texts (src/server.ts:83, src/admin-routes.ts:97). Bearer regex twice with different rules (src/tokens.ts:99, src/server.ts:253); SHA-256 digest twice (src/server.ts:243, src/tokens.ts:101). Self-rescheduling timer loop four times (src/heartbeat.ts:89, src/config-reload.ts:154, src/retention.ts:80, src/latency-rollup.ts:60), also status src/api-poll.ts:16 and probe src/reloader.ts. Local MAX_TIMER_MS (src/location-silence.ts:3) next to the contract's MAX_TIMER_MS (imported at src/config.ts:9). No duplication of SLO, uptime or component state math (api uses the contract's combineStates and aggregateUptime). All except finding 9 are notes.

checklist.item: Dead code. Exports that nothing imports and files that nothing reaches, found with grep and tsc.
checklist.evidence: tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters: exit 0, no output. Export scan (Bun script, word match of every src export over src, bench, scripts): exit 0; exports without a production user in finding 10 (test-only reader src/config.ts:466-504, parseChecks, INITIAL_STATE, SCHEMA_VERSION, validateResult, maxFutureSkewMs, bound constants, nearestRank, fillAllRollups, cleanupResults, retentionCutoff; unused ConfigAction src/config-write.ts:15 and LatencyRollupRunner.done src/latency-rollup.ts:26). Reachability from src/main.ts, src/backup-main.ts, bench/run.ts and bench/selftest/*.ts: only bench/seed.ts is not imported, and bench/run.ts:117 runs it as a subprocess, so no file is unreached. Unreachable branches: finding 9.

checklist.item: Test quality. Coverage from the repository's own test script where it reports it; risky branches without a test; tests that assert nothing or only mirror the implementation.
checklist.evidence: bun run test: exit 0, 407 pass, 0 fail, 57 files; coverage 96.99 % funcs, 99.19 % lines (threshold 80 % lines). Uncovered: src/config-fs.ts 40-42, src/config-reload.ts 112-113 and 122, src/latency-rollup.ts 92-93, src/service.ts 68 (finding 13). src/main.ts and src/backup-main.ts are not in the table (Bun lists only loaded files); lcov marks the unreachable src/server.ts:147 as run (DA:147,38), so line coverage overstates (note). A scan of 375 test bodies found no test without an assertion; no skip, todo or only. Bound tests mirror the implementation (finding 4). Untested retry after an apply failure (finding 1). Wall-clock assertions at src/uptime.test.ts:125 (< 1000 ms) and src/db.wal.test.ts:61 (< 50 ms) against the AGENTS.md no-real-clock rule (note). src/docs-claims.test.ts asserts doc wording (note).

checklist.item: Error handling. Swallowed errors (empty or log-only catch, ignored promise rejections) and error shapes that differ for the same kind of failure.
checklist.evidence: grep -nE -A4 'catch( \(\w+\))? \{|\.catch\(' src/*.ts and reading each block. Catches that drop the caught error all carry a reason comment (src/backup.ts:110, 116, src/config-write.ts:415, src/main.ts:13, src/server.ts:206, 273, 520, src/service.ts:68, 1116, src/admin-routes.ts:108). Log-only catches in the four background loops (src/heartbeat.ts:95, src/retention.ts:95, src/latency-rollup.ts:84, src/config-reload.ts:161) are by design; two log at info and vanish at PULSE_LOG_LEVEL=warn (finding 2); the reload apply failure logs only err.name, counts invalid and is not retried (finding 1). An error after the answer was sent is not logged (finding 6). no-floating-promises and no-misused-promises pass; the void-discarded promises catch internally. Different shapes for one failure: missing tokens file against missing checks file (finding 11), 405 with or without Allow (finding 5), Error subclasses without name (finding 12), 404 'unknown check' on /checks/:id/latency (src/server.ts:639) against 'unknown check "<id>"' elsewhere (documented, note).

checklist.item: Consistency. Deviations from the repository's AGENTS.md and from the other services: naming, module layout, configuration handling.
checklist.evidence: AGENTS.md deviations: complexity suppression (finding 3), Error subclasses without name (finding 12), silent error (finding 6), exports only for tests (finding 10), SQL outside src/service.ts in src/manual-incidents.ts:89-112 (12 statements; docs part in finding 8), file I/O with readFileSync in src/config.ts:469 and 509 while the reload path injects ReloadFs (note), '(err as Error)' casts without a check at src/config.ts:471 and 511 (note), ConfigError without cause at src/config.ts:471 (note), boolean names stopped (src/heartbeat.ts:90), fresh and checkForeignKeys (src/db.ts:113-114) (style, notes). Return types, import extensions, node: prefixes, named exports, no barrels: no deviation. Configuration handling: probe and status read their environment in one src/settings.ts; api spreads it over src/start.ts:79, src/retention.ts:9 (days read with readMs) and src/location-silence.ts:6 (note). Pins: contract pin is contract main; kit pin fa79ba8 is behind kit main but src/ is identical (diff -rq); probe, status and notify pin the same kit.

checklist.item: Docs against code. Claims in the README and docs/ of this repository that the code does not match, each with the claim and the contradicting code.
checklist.evidence: Read README.md and all of docs/, checked claims against the code, a local bun start on 127.0.0.1 and scratch scripts. Contradictions: docs/operation.md:224 Allow on every 405 (finding 5), docs/rest-api.md:145 several rows per location and timestamp (finding 7), docs/development.md:22, 24, 26 code layout (finding 8), docs/development.md:51 and AGENTS.md:77 complexity limit against the suppressed handle (finding 3). Notes: docs/troubleshooting.md:115 'GET on every other path', docs/operation.md:195 incomplete listening fields (src/start.ts:295-311), docs/concepts.md:107 rollups of checks no longer in the database (the API never deletes checks). Correct: start errors and exit code 2 for seven bad settings and missing files, exit 0 on SIGTERM, POST /results idempotence and check order, the troubleshooting 400 messages, nearest-rank, 5 s backfill delay and read cache, the environment table.
